value.rationale: A static position/gate propagator recovers at most the parity of crossings, not throughput counts. The full finite-offset marked-count transform and state-dependent first-translocation tail give operational observables for dynamically gated membranes. The asymptotic count remains non-self-averaging with squared coefficient of variation \(\pi/2-1\) and quantifies how open duty cycle controls transport without eliminating relative fluctuations.
